name: kiro
description: Claude plans, Kiro implements and reviews — a cost-savings delegation plugin. Claude designs specs and verifies results while Kiro CLI (subscription credits) writes the code inside an isolated worktree and can optionally review diffs before commit.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate implementation to Kiro CLI to save tokens.
interface.longDescription: Plan with the current host and delegate implementation to Kiro CLI in an isolated worktree. Codex skills expose setup, configuration, delegation, read-only review and the delegate procedure; adapted commit/push hooks retain their configured review behavior. Verify captured changes and tests before landing them.
